intro: A glass of neslo ais at the mamak has about 200 kcal (estimate). Most of it comes from sweetened condensed milk, chocolate malt powder and sugar.

variants.name: Neslo ais kosong (no milk, no sugar)

diet: Yes, if it's once in a while and you control the sweetness. 200 kcal per glass is easy to overlook because it's 'just a drink'. Two glasses a day is already 400 kcal without feeling full. Try making neslo a treat, not your usual drink every time you lepak.
tips: Order 'kurang manis' or 'kurang susu' at the mamak.
Ask for neslo 'kosong' and add a little evaporated milk yourself.
If you're thirsty, ask for a glass of warm water too, so you don't finish the neslo too fast.

swap.name: Kopi O ais kurang manis
swap.why: You still get the cold coffee taste, without the condensed milk and sugary chocolate malt powder.

faq.a: Neslo is a mix of instant coffee and chocolate malt drink, usually with condensed milk. It's popular at mamak shops.

faq.q: Does neslo have more caffeine than normal coffee?
faq.a: Usually about the same or a bit less than normal coffee, depending on how much coffee the shop puts in.

faq.q: Is it okay to drink neslo before exercise?
faq.a: Some people like it because the caffeine and sugar give quick energy. Just pick the kurang manis version so you don't overdo the calories.
